title: Implement schema-aware request parameter construction
objective: Construct and validate parameters from a flat schema, nested dot/index assignments, and full --parameters JSON with deterministic precedence and errors. Contract sections: requests/README.md#request-defaults-and-parameter-defaults; requests/README.md#parameter-contract; requests/README.md#x-llm-req-parameter-metadata. Explicit human operator confirmation is required before modifying requests/README.md.

branch.name: llm-request-lookup
branch.rationale: The record captures bounded planning without creating or switching a branch.

request.text: Prepare small, testable work items for dynamic request lookup: document requests/README.md; support request asset discovery; schema-aware CLI parameters including dot/index paths and --parameters JSON; $${variableName}$$ substitution; completeRequest({ requestName, parameters, files, ... }); llm req CLI integration; raw/full output; summarize compatibility; provider-free validation.

scope.name: root-properties
scope.description: Flat root properties are exposed as CLI parameters and parameter is reserved.
scope.reason: The schema defines the request-specific namespace.

scope.name: nested-paths
scope.description: Dot notation and array/map indexes update nested values without corrupting siblings.
scope.reason: Structured request parameters need navigable assignment.

scope.name: full-object
scope.description: --parameters accepts full JSON and individual assignments follow documented precedence.
scope.reason: Full-object callers and targeted operators both need deterministic behavior.

scope.name: schema-validation
scope.description: The complete object is validated against parameters.schema.json, including x-llm-req-parameter metadata, before substitution.
scope.reason: Schema violations must not invoke completion.

scope.name: authoritative-contract
scope.description: Implement only the authoritative contract sections [Request defaults and parameter defaults](#request-defaults-and-parameter-defaults), [Parameter contract](#parameter-contract), [x-llm-req-parameter metadata](#x-llm-req-parameter-metadata). Do not modify requests/README.md without explicit human operator confirmation.
scope.reason: The request README is the source of truth for this implementation batch.

nonGoals.name: implementation
nonGoals.description: Do not implement behavior outside this work item.

nonGoals.name: provider-and-release
nonGoals.description: Do not make authenticated calls, publish, deploy, or claim production readiness.

nonGoals.name: unrelated-refactor
nonGoals.description: Do not redesign unrelated commands, providers, schemas, or persistence.
nonGoals.reason: Scope is limited to dynamic request lookup.
